filing.title: Vyra Therapeutics Corp. 10-K annual report
filing.bodyText:
FORM 10-K
Vyra Therapeutics Corp. (Exact name of registrant as specified in its charter)
For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
Trading Symbol(s) VYRA Nasdaq Capital Market
Liquidity and Capital Resources
Revenue was $7.2 million for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to $9.4 million in the prior year. The company incurred a net loss of $88.0 million for the year. Cash and cash equivalents were $14.0 million at December 31, 2025. Total debt was $55.0 million. Management concluded that these conditions raise substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern. We will require additional capital to fund operations beyond the third quarter of 2026.
